newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Sparta, N.J..

text.p: Book Entry Only Bonds, Bank Qualified, Callable
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Township at the Municipal Building, 65 Main Street, Sparta, New Jersey 07871 on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Township dated April 1, 1997 and due (subject to prior redemption) on April 1 as follows:
Bonds Bonds Combined Bonds Bonds Combined
Principal Principal Maturity Principal Principal Maturity
Year Amount Amount Schedule Year Amount Amount Schedule

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Township in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Township will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J.
The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates

annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on October 1 and April 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on October 1, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Michael T. Catapano, the Chief Financial Officer at 65 Main Street, Sparta, New Jersey 07871 (201) 729-4903.
